title: Cat Sitting
excerpt: Once or twice daily home visits while you're away, so your cat avoids the stress of an unfamiliar cattery.
intro: Dedicated, experienced cat sitting. We visit your cat once or twice a day while you're on holiday, so they stay in their own home instead of an unfamiliar cattery. We can also keep your home looking lived-in while you're away.
highlights: Let out in the morning and called in for the evening, if you'd like them safe indoors overnight
Plants watered and post picked up
Curtains opened and drawn, and lights timed, for added security
Karina, our co-owner, is a registered veterinary nurse, so medication is in safe hands
pricingNote: All prices include VAT. Key holding is free.
